outlooks.label: Earliest generic launch allowed by court settlements

basis.en: Generic apixaban is FDA-approved, but legal settlements allow sales no earlier than April 1, 2028. This is not a promised launch date.
basis.zh-Hans: 阿哌沙班仿制药已获 FDA 批准，但根据法律和解协议，最早要到2028年4月1日才能开始销售。这不是承诺的上市日期。
